sources.title: GitHub - VisionOPD/Vision-OPD: Vision-OPD is a regional-to-global on ...
sources.snippet: Overview Vision-OPD is a regional-to-global on-policy self-distillation framework that transfers a model's own privileged regional perception to its full-image policy, enabling fine-grained visual understanding in a single forward pass — without external teachers, ground-truth labels, reward verifiers, or inference-time tool use.
